requiredDeliverables: Current v2 catalog file paths resolve. Supply independent approved SVG pose/gesture layers for the entries still marked Partial; original filenames are only provenance.
assetRequests.acceptance: Every intended production pose has a verified v2 binding; supplied raster crops remain references.
resolvedInV2: Facial asset paths in consolidated Character Pack

assetRequests.title: Opposite-facing head/body and mutual gaze
requiredDeliverables: Approved male-facing-right/female-facing-left matching 3/4 views, with facial features aligned toward partner.
Optional opposite arrangement with separately approved asymmetric details; no automatic mirroring.
Eye aim or gaze target specification.
assetRequests.acceptance: Both face axes and eye direction point toward partner; shell, heart and antenna placement approved.

assetRequests.title: Reach, touch and hold arm binding
requiredDeliverables: Separate approved Open, Touch and Hold SVG arm variants for both characters, with hidden shoulder/elbow overlap.
Named shoulder, elbow, wrist and surface-contact anchors in the same production coordinate system.
One paired standing contact reference at approved relative scale, with both feet on the same baseline.
assetRequests.acceptance: Geometric v2 touch now passes within 2px with no unintended overlap. Remaining work: approved Open/Touch/Hold SVG shape binding and holding-grip validation.
resolvedInV2: Fixed v2 rest lengths / original mount positions during playback
Hand surface anchor coincidence at phase 0.5
Rendered surface proximity and no inter-character overlap

assetRequests.title: Head and shoulder surface contacts
requiredDeliverables: Approved seated/standing lean pair with independent character layers.
Head-side surface and receiving shoulder surface anchors, normals and permitted compression/overlap.
assetRequests.acceptance: Surface contacts verified after transforms; no rolling a front head to fake yaw; seated ground contact retained.

assetRequests.title: Comforting a sad partner
requiredDeliverables: Approved sad partner full-body pose with receiving shoulder/hand contact.
Approved comforting arm and face in the same view; attach actual facial SVG files referenced by expression catalog.
Entry, contact hold and release reference keys.
assetRequests.acceptance: Sad expression actually exists in the shown asset; comfort contact and occlusion are verified without stretching.

assetRequests.title: Gift offer assets
requiredDeliverables: Separate approved gift prop SVG, front/back layers and prop grip anchors.
Bound Gift arms and receiving-hand pose, with full-body pair reference.
Gift ownership at offer/accept/release keys; no ownership change until approved handoff artwork exists.
assetRequests.acceptance: Both prop grip anchors match hands; no invented prop or unapproved receiving pose.

assetRequests.title: Seated pair and occlusion layers
requiredDeliverables: Independent approved seated and hugging SVG layers, with far/near arms and complete hidden torso/neck areas.
hip.seat, support-hand.floor, torso.contact and mutual arm-contact anchors.
Corresponding entry/exit full-body keys and user-approved timing if smooth playback is required.
assetRequests.acceptance: Feet/seat fixed as applicable, forearm order matches approved composite and no torso/face is erased to fake contact.

contactSolution.method: Bounded discrete search followed by continuous least-squares refinement; ground, authored limb lengths and calibrated character scales fixed.

calibration.headNote: Total height includes antenna, but helmet/head proportions are reviewed separately. Source head shapes remain unchanged.
calibration.scalePolicy: Constant per character fitted to approved neutral-pair total-height ratio. Set once at calibration, never adjusted to force contact.
calibration.measurementLimit: Source outline bbox uses integer pixels and a dark-ink threshold; not an anatomical landmark measurement. Independent production heads differ slightly from artistic pair-sheet poses.

approvalPolicy: User supplied rigs/reference sheets are source assets. New choreography remains review work, not an approval claim.
